Always jumps to what\'s airing right now.

WMTU Radio keeps a short rolling buffer of the live broadcast in memory -- not saved to your device\'s storage -- so a brief pause doesn\'t lose your spot. The buffer clears when you reload the stream, close the app, or restart your device. A longer buffer lets you pause longer without losing your place, at the cost of a bit more memory while playing. Changes apply the next time the stream reloads.
Built in support of Reggae Adjacent with DJ TomASS, live on WMTU.fm Mondays at 6pm.

WMTU 91.9 FM is Michigan Technological University\'s student-run, non-commercial radio station, broadcasting from Houghton, Michigan. Programming is chosen and run by MTU students, including shows like Reggae Adjacent with DJ TomASS.
Michigan Technological University is a public research university in Houghton, Michigan, founded in 1885. WMTU operates as part of MTU\'s student media.
